name: Symmetric Givens Rotation (Jacobi SVD)
definition: An iterative method to diagonalize a 3x3 symmetric matrix using Givens rotations, implemented via Schur2 and SVD classes. It computes the eigenvalues and eigenvectors by zeroing off-diagonal elements.
summary: Symmetric Givens Rotation is an iterative method that diagonalizes 3x3 symmetric matrices using orthogonal transformations, offering numerical stability for ill-conditioned data at the cost of speed compared to closed-form solutions.
